{
  "summary": "Drafting bounded test implementation for the fifth-overlay update. The update introduces fallback logic for approved EasyList transports, replacing terminal errors with a fallback attempt. Tests must now account for `primary_failure`/`fallback_outcome` diagnostics and the new `OngoingDownload` struct. Key scenarios include valid primary downloads, primary failure triggering successful fallback (canonical identity), dual failures (callback/error count), race conditions (cancellation/stale primary vs. stale conversion), and metadata rejection (redirects). Existing tests like `HttpFailureHasReason...` and `StaleConversion...` require updates to reflect that a primary failure is no longer necessarily terminal.",
  "architecture_observations": [
    "`OngoingDownload` is now a struct instead of a tuple.",
    "Approved transports now support a single fallback attempt before terminal error.",
    "Canonical identity is preserved for approved mappings.",
    "New diagnostics: `primary_failure`, `fallback_outcome`, and `fallback_attempted`.",
    "Strict transport policy: redirects are rejected for approved lists."
  ],
  "proposed_changes": [
    {
      "file": "components/adblock/test/shields_diagnostics_unittest.cc",
      "change": "Add new test cases for fallback logic and update existing failure tests to handle the fallback attempt phase."
    }
  ],
  "patch": "",
  "risks": [
    "Existing tests assuming immediate failure on primary error will fail.",
    "Race conditions between stale primary and stale conversion might be harder to reproduce with new struct-based state."
  ],
  "tests": [
    "Valid primary (no fallback).",
    "Primary failure -> Fallback success (canonical identity).",
    "Both failure (check error count/callback).",
    "Cancelled/Stale primary vs Stale conversion race.",
    "Metadata redirect rejection.",
    "Lookalikes (no fallback)."
  ]
}
